Shattered Legacy's own map changes, as a patch (cc-P188, 2026-10-20). Ours: nothing of EA's is in this folder.

trammel.mapops   facet 1 (Trammel): the Rootdeep Burrows (x 5136-5247, y 1128-1263; cc-P167, P180, P181, P185,
                 approved by Chase 2026-10-19) and the way in from Old Haven (the Second Bank of Haven: three
                 ruined-wall pieces removed from its south wall at 3618-3620,2622, the hole 0x1B71 at 3619,2620, and
                 the rope ladder 0x08A6 on the Landing's north wall at 5193,1131).
                 cc-P276, 2026-10-21 (Chase approved): the tutorial farm west of New Haven (fence x 3381-3399,
                 y 2603-2619): the two trees inside its fence removed, a willow at 3388,2607 (0x0CE6 trunk, 0x0CE7
                 leaves) and a walnut at 3396,2616 (0x0CE0, 0x0CE1). Four S- lines, nothing added.
                 cc-P413, 2026-10-24: the hole 0x1B71 at 3619,2620 is replaced by an ant-hill burrow in the same bank:
                 OSI's 6 x 6 sinkhole set 0x30E7-0x310A (a dirt crater round a dark hole, laid as OSI lays it at
                 5575,3015) at x 3615-3620, y 2616-2621, its dark mouth x 3617-3619, y 2617-2620, with thirteen loose
                 rocks and debris on the rim (0x1771-0x177C, 0x0C2E-0x0C30, all passable): 49 S+ lines added, the
                 hole's one S+ line gone, one more B line.
                 cc-P662, 2026-10-26: the Wakening Isle (x 6594-6865, y 3905-4049, site A of cc-P673).
                 cc-P675, 2026-10-28 (SoS swap S2): RE-BASED onto the Siege of Sosaria map by Zigholtul
                 (player-package/vendor/sos-trammel-map; pristine hashes in shard-migration
                 notes/cc-P675-tools/sos-base/ORIGINAL-SHA256.txt). The Burrows' 210 blocks and the isle's 665
                 apply as they were (both sit on void in his map; no block drifted). Dropped: the way in from Old
                 Haven (its 2 blocks; that bank is the author's Second Bank of Haven now, and cc-P678's cellar
                 hatch is a server item) and cc-P276's four farm removals (the farm is on the isle; the old spot
                 is his forest). Every B line now fingerprints his blocks, not EA's.
                 cc-P720, 2026-10-28 (Chase's isle walk, round 2): the isle rebuilt in place by the same driver
                 (notes/cc-P662-tools/build_isle.py, on the SoS copy): the bank and the lodge as OSI's stone shop
                 (windows, pitched shingle roof, gable) and furnished; no meadow fence; no flowers by the road; the
                 sand under the dock's shore end at the beach's height, so the planks are one step up. Same 875
                 blocks; 3,435 S+ lines.
                 cc-P725, 2026-10-29 (Chase 10-28: shore tiles, a tropical island): the isle rebuilt in place
                 by the same driver: the coast laid with OSI's surf pieces (0x179D-0x17B2) by a rule learned from
                 stock Trammel's sandy beaches (notes/cc-P725-tools/survey_rule.py, shore-rule.json), the first sand
                 ring at -4 in place of P662's plain water diamond, and the island planted with stock tropical art
                 (palms, banana, o'hii, OSI's jungle trees whole, ferns, pampas). Same 875 blocks; 4,618 S+ lines.
                 cc-P687, 2026-10-29 (SoS swap S14): the author's cliff seams dressed near where players go: on
                 every bare grass, dirt, sand, forest, jungle or snow tile within 40 of a town, road or moongate
                 that stands 20 or more above its south or east neighbour (a new seam: not the same one on stock),
                 OSI's tall grey boulders (0x1357-0x135C) at the low side's Z, one more each 20 Z, each under the
                 tile's walking Z (notes/cc-P687-tools/dress.py). S14's five closure boxes are fenced instead.
                 8,389 S+ lines on 6,143 faces.

Format: shard-migration scripts/mapbuild/mapops.py (one line per changed land cell, L x y tile z; per static added,
S+ x y z id hue; per EA static removed, S- x y z id hue; B lines fingerprint EA's blocks so the applier can say
when EA changed one under us). Made by:

    python -P scripts/mapbuild/mapops.py diff <a pristine SoS copy> <the scratch build> 1 trammel.mapops

and checked by the same tool (check) and shard-migration tools/tests/test_mapops.py, which also proves the player
side applier (payload/app/Apply-MapOps.ps1) writes the same bytes. The package ships it as app/trammel.mapops; Play.ps1
applies it to copies of the player's own files through Build-UoOverrides.ps1.
